description: Washington, D.C. – Today, Texas Democratic Delegation Chair Congresswoman Lizzie Fletcher (TX-07), Democratic Leader Jeffries, Democratic Whip Katherine Clark, DCCC Chairwoman Suzan DelBene, and members of the Texas Democratic Delegation held a press conference on Texas Governor Greg Abbott’s addition of congressional redistricting to the special legislative session scheduled to begin on July 21.
